thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: gpu-pool-us-west-1 saturated — queue length 5,200, 95th latency > 3s. Autoscaler failed to provision new instances (error: quotaExceeded). Paging on-call.

oncall-mike: I’m on it, joining bridge. tagging SREs @sre-alex and infra @infra-sam.

sre-alex: I see the alert on the dashboard. Autoscaler shows repeated provision attempts, then cloud returns 403/quotaExceeded for instanceGroup 'rw-gpu-usw-1'. Queue growth correlates with a spike in batchable requests.

eng-runtime-rita: Any recent pushes to autoscale config? I didn't merge anything to prod today.

infra-sam: No config changes from infra in last 24h. Cloud quota should be unchanged. I'll check provider console for pending requests and quotas.

ops-bot: Bridge started: https://meet.redwood/bridge/5225004321 (auto) 

cs-luis: Heads-up from support — we have 3 customers reporting increased throttling and timeouts. One reported failed embeddings call in the last 10m.

product-jess: Prioritize customer-facing mitigations. Can we route non-SLA traffic to a degraded variant?

oncall-mike: Immediate plan: 1) enable temporary routing of lower-tier traffic to quantized model variant (v2-q4) 2) reduce max_batch_size on heavy routes 3) open cloud quota ticket and fallback routing to eu-west if need be. Assigning tasks.

sre-alex: I'll flip the routing rules. Doing a safe canary first (10% traffic).

eng-runtime-rita: CLI to update routing (doing now):
```
# route 10% of traffic to quantized variant
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/route -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"redwood-model-v2-q4","percent":10}'
```

sre-alex: Canary applied. Monitoring queue.

oncall-mike: Sam — can you check the autoscaler logs for the exact cloud error and timestamp? Use this:
```
kubectl logs deployment/autoscaler -n rw-system --since=15m | grep quotaExceeded
```

infra-sam: Found repeated failures starting at 5225004250: cloud API returned quotaExceeded for CreateInstance requests for gpu-n1-standard. Copying log snippet:
```
E 5225004253 autoscaler.go:211 provision failed: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded.
```

eng-runtime-rita: Canary shows 7% reduction in queue growth for canary users. Good sign.

product-jess: CS — please surface highest-value customers impacted so we can prioritize routing for them.

cs-luis: Sent a DM to the three affected accounts. One is in EU and already fails over to eu region, but two are US-only. They've seen 504s.

oncall-mike: Next step: increase canary to 50% and then 100% if stable. Also reduce max_batch_size on /v1/generate routes to lower queue head-of-line delays.

sre-alex: Increasing canary to 50% now.

eng-runtime-rita: Reduce batch size config change:
```
# in runtime config
routes:
  /v1/generate:
    max_batch_size: 8  # was 32
    max_latency_ms: 1200
```
Applying...

ops-bot: Deploy triggered: deploy/24620 by eng-runtime-rita — rolling update started.

infra-sam: Cloud quota ticket opened: https://console.cloud/support/123456 — requesting GPU quota raise (+50 GPUs). ETA 4–6 hours.

noname: (misc note) We should avoid "noname" speaker — ignore.

sre-alex: Queue growth slowed after batch size reduction and 50% canary. Current queue 1,200 and dropping. 95th latency back to ~1.3s.

oncall-mike: Good. But quota ticket ETA is several hours. We need medium-term mitigations in case quota request stalls.

eng-runtime-rita: Adding additional fallback: route best-effort traffic to eu-west pool where capacity exists. Will add routing rule to send customer tags with low priority to eu-west.

product-jess: Document the customer-visible degradations: quantized outputs may be slightly lower-fidelity. CS please coordinate messaging.

cs-luis: Draft message posted in #support-drafts for review.

infra-sam: Also found an autoscaler regression: we were requesting a specific accelerator SKU (v100-custom) which is constrained in us-west. We should fall back to a compatible SKU (a100 or a different shape) when quota is tight. Filing short-term patch.

sre-alex: Quick mitigation checklist run — all green except cloud quota: routing rules applied, batch size reduced, EU fallback in place.

oncall-mike: Triage summary for bridge: impact = degraded throughput and increased 504s for a subset of US customers; mitigations applied: routing to quantized variant (50%→100%), batch size lowered, eu fallback enabled; root immediate cause: cloud GPU quota exhaustion combined with autoscaler requesting constrained SKU.

eng-runtime-rita: Can we add a short circuit to autoscaler: if CreateInstance returns quotaExceeded, try alternate SKUs/regions before giving up? I can PR a fallback in autoscaler next hour.

infra-sam: I'll add an infra change to allow cross-region burst for small % of traffic (policy + IAM checks).

product-jess: Who's owning the customer comms and the postmortem?

cs-luis: I'll handle comms with Sales/AE help.

sre-alex: I’ll own the postmortem. Drafting timeline now and will invite eng-runtime, infra, and product. Proposed postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT.

oncall-mike: Action items (short):
- infra-sam: escalate quota with provider + propose fallback SKU policy (in flight) 
- eng-runtime-rita: autoscaler fallback PR to try alternate SKUs/regions on quota errors 
- sre-alex: write postmortem + timeline + RCA 
- cs-luis: customer comms draft and priority list 
- product-jess: approve messaging and identify SLA customers

ops-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 by oncall-mike.

sre-alex: Final check: queue steady ~900 and decreasing; will keep monitoring until quota resolved. If we see re-acceleration, we'll re-open bridge.

oncall-mike: Thanks team. Please add any notes to the incident doc: https://vault.redwood/incidents/5225004321. We'll reconvene if anything changes. :thumbsup:

product-jess: Two follow-up asks for postmortem: 1) add metric to alert on autoscaler quotaDenied ratio > 5% 2) add playbook step to route to degraded model variant automatically when autoscaler fails 3 times in 10m.

sre-alex: Noted and adding to action items. Closing bridge unless new alerts.

ops-bot: Bridge ended at 5225004700.
